question_text: A 73-year-old man is brought to the emergency department by ambulance after being found to be non-communicative by his family during dinner. On presentation he appears to be alert, though he is confused and cannot follow instructions. When he tries to speak, he vocalizes a string of fluent but unintelligible syllables. Given this presentation, his physician decides to administer tissue plasminogen activator to this patient. This intervention best represents which of the following principles?

        ### Question
        A 73-year-old man is brought to the emergency department by ambulance after being found to be non-communicative by his family during dinner. On presentation he appears to be alert, though he is confused and cannot follow instructions. When he tries to speak, he vocalizes a string of fluent but unintelligible syllables. Given this presentation, his physician decides to administer tissue plasminogen activator to this patient. This intervention best represents which of the following principles?

        ### Options
        opa. Primary prevention
opb. Seconday prevention
opc. Tertiary prevention
opd. Quartenary prevention
ope. This does not represent prevention

### Reasoning Chains per Option:

### Retrieved Evidence Paths (broad but correct):
(Alteplase)-TREATS->(Acute Ischemic Stroke)
